name: AINumbers Anchor Suite
description: Hash anchoring and verifiable timestamping at anchor.ainumbers.co: RFC 3161 (TSA) and OpenTimestamps anchoring of SHA-256 digests with up to seven independent authorities, Merkle batch anchoring (up to 1024 items, one timestamp call), offline binding verification against pinned roots, Sigsum witness cosigning with OTS calendar upgrade, and passkey-backed signature envelopes with escalation-closure verification. File bytes never leave the browser — only the digest (or the batch Merkle root) is sent to the timestamp authorities. Emits OpenChainGraph-conformant anchor_bindings.

extensions.description: Emits OpenChainGraph-conformant anchor_bindings (hash-anchored, RFC 4998 evidence records). See the OpenChainGraph Standard.

skills.name: Hash Anchoring & Timestamping
skills.description: Anchor a SHA-256 digest with independent RFC 3161 timestamp authorities (Sigstore TSA, Sigsum, DigiCert, Sectigo, FreeTSA, GitHub TSA) and OpenTimestamps (Bitcoin-anchored); batch-anchor up to 1024 digests under one Merkle root; upgrade Sigsum bindings with OTS calendar proofs.
examples: Anchor this SHA-256 digest with Sigstore and DigiCert
Batch-anchor these digests under one Merkle root
Upgrade this Sigsum binding to a Bitcoin-anchored OTS proof

skills.name: Binding Verification & Receipts
skills.description: Offline verification of anchor bindings (DER parse, message-imprint check, TSA signature chain to pinned roots), passkey-backed signature envelope creation and verification, and escalation-closure verification.
examples: Verify this RFC 3161 anchor binding against its anchored hash
Create a passkey signature envelope for this artifact
